description: React component for managing and rendering an application form container with submission, refresh, and lookup functionalities in Mattermost.

classes.name: AppsFormContainer
classes.description: React component class handling app form logic, including submission, refresh, and lookup calls.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, processes app call responses, and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: refreshOnSelect
methods.description: Handles refresh actions when a form field is selected, updating the form dynamically.

methods.name: performLookupCall
methods.description: Performs lookup actions for form fields based on user input.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the AppsForm component if form and context are available.
